#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds a self-contained jar (Kotlin runtime included) and an ./app launcher.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

mkdir -p build
kotlinc src/main/kotlin -jvm-target 21 -Xjdk-release=21 -include-runtime -d build/app.jar

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
exec java -XX:+UseSerialGC -Xss512k -cp "$dir/build/app.jar" kvhttp.MainKt "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

package kvhttp

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer
import java.net.InetAddress
import java.net.InetSocketAddress
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import kotlin.system.exitProcess

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val port = args.singleOrNull()?.toIntOrNull()?.takeIf { it in 1..65535 }
    if (port == null) {
        System.err.println("usage: app <port>")
        exitProcess(2)
    }
    val server = HttpServer.create(InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), port), 1024)
    server.createContext("/", KvHandler(KvStore()))
    server.executor = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()
    server.start()
}
